claims.sourceText: air-and-space.com, Lockheed A-12 / YF-12 / SR-71 Blackbirds collection, https://www.air-and-space.com/Lockheed%20A-12%20YF-12%20SR-71%20Blackbirds.htm , read 2026-09-18, event date 1988-11-12
claims.text: An air show was held at Norton Air Force Base on 12 November 1988, and an SR-71A flew at it. A private photographic collection of Blackbird aircraft carries a section headed 'Norton Air Force Base Airshow, November 12, 1988' with captions including 'SR-71A 61-7962 at Norton AFB on November 12, 1988' and 'The crew of SR-71A 61-7962 shake hands before departing the November 12, 1988 Norton Air Force Base airshow'. This is the only opened record that dates the air show independently of the ARV account.

edges.note: Both primary documents place the account at Norton AFB, and the air show itself is dated at the base independently by a Blackbird photographic collection.

edges.label: Air Force open house; the 1990 notes describe Air Force briefers
edges.note: The air show is an Air Force open house and is documented as such. The briefers inside the alleged exhibit are described only in the witness's words: uniforms in 'Blue; Air Force', 'Colonel, major, something like that'. No Air Force record of the exhibit was opened.
